Requirement_Text: The lighting module shall operate from 9.0 V to 16.0 V input without loss of commanded function.
Assumptions: Nominal 12 V vehicle supply; transient events excluded from this demo
Proposed_Test: Bench input voltage sweep at low/nominal/high values

Requirement_Text: Low beam output shall remain enabled when commanded ON and input voltage is within the normal operating range.
Assumptions: Optical performance values are not included in this demo
Proposed_Test: Command low beam ON across voltage cases and log output state

Requirement_Text: High beam output shall remain disabled unless the high beam command is active.
Assumptions: Command source is simulated
Proposed_Test: Command truth-table test for high beam enable/disable

Requirement_Text: The DRL mode shall command reduced current relative to full-intensity operation.
Assumptions: Reduction target is synthetic and must be configured per demo case
Proposed_Test: Compare commanded current in full and DRL modes

Requirement_Text: The tool shall flag any requirement that lacks a verification method.
Assumptions: Applies to portfolio tool output, not product design
Proposed_Test: Review generated trace matrix for blank verification fields

Requirement_Text: The output report shall separate assumptions from verified facts.
Assumptions: Facts in demo are generated synthetic values
Proposed_Test: Inspect report sections for assumption and fact separation

Requirement_Text: All public examples shall be labeled as synthetic demonstration data.
Assumptions: Public portfolio boundary applies
Proposed_Test: Check exported files for synthetic-data banner

Requirement_Text: Thermal review shall be required if estimated board temperature exceeds the configured demo threshold.
Assumptions: Threshold is synthetic and conservative for demo purposes
Proposed_Test: Run feasibility calculation and inspect risk flag

Requirement_Text: The trace matrix shall include requirement ID, subsystem, requirement type, verification method, risk, and review status.
Assumptions: Column names are defined by the source-pack schema
Proposed_Test: Inspect exported CSV/XLSX headers

Requirement_Text: Ambiguous requirements shall be flagged before inclusion in a design-review packet.
Assumptions: Ambiguity scoring is proposed by AI and reviewed by engineer
Proposed_Test: Review ambiguity flag and reviewer disposition

Requirement_Text: The system shall record open questions generated during requirements review.
Assumptions: Questions are generated from synthetic text
Proposed_Test: Inspect open-question register

Requirement_Text: AI-generated classifications shall remain draft until a qualified engineer reviews them.
Assumptions: Applies to all AI outputs
Proposed_Test: Check review status field before publish/export

Requirement_Text: Diagnostic fault output shall set a review flag within 100 ms after a synthetic open-load condition is injected.
Assumptions: Fault thresholds are synthetic demonstration values
Proposed_Test: Inject synthetic open-load condition and inspect diagnostic flag

Requirement_Text: Input protection shall tolerate reverse connection for 60 s in a synthetic bench setup without claiming production approval.
Assumptions: Reverse-connection limits are demo-only and require review
Proposed_Test: Run synthetic reverse-input timing check and record review flag

Requirement_Text: Thermal derating shall reduce LED current when estimated junction temperature exceeds 115 C in the synthetic model.
Assumptions: Junction-temperature threshold is not a product limit
Proposed_Test: Compare commanded current before and after synthetic derating threshold

Requirement_Text: WCCA prep report shall list missing tolerance values before margin calculations are discussed.
Assumptions: Tolerance defaults are placeholders until engineer review
Proposed_Test: Inspect missing-data warnings before reviewing WCCA summary

Requirement_Text: Requirements marked Internal only shall be excluded from any public export package.
Assumptions: Publication classification controls are part of the demo workflow
Proposed_Test: Review export package for blocked-public rows

Requirement_Text: Reviewer disposition shall include reviewer name date status and comment before a row is treated as reviewed.
Assumptions: Reviewer fields remain placeholders in generated demo outputs
Proposed_Test: Inspect reviewer disposition fields in the generated checklist

Requirement_Text: Boost driver duty cycle shall remain below 0.62 at minimum synthetic input voltage.
Assumptions: Duty-cycle threshold is a synthetic screening limit
Proposed_Test: Run feasibility calculation and inspect boost duty flag

Requirement_Text: Low beam diagnostic fallback should command a defined synthetic output state after communication timeout.
Assumptions: Fallback response is a draft review item
Proposed_Test: Inject synthetic communication timeout and inspect fallback row

Requirement_Text: Design review packet shall include a validation gap row for every open risk.
Assumptions: Open risk list is generated from synthetic notes
Proposed_Test: Compare risk register rows against validation gap rows

Requirement_Text: Plot-derived LED model export shall preserve source page and curve ID in metadata.
Assumptions: Curve source labels are synthetic placeholders
Proposed_Test: Inspect LED model metadata fields in the export package

Requirement_Text: Assumptions register shall separate AI-drafted assumptions from reviewer-accepted decisions.
Assumptions: Reviewer-accepted decisions are not generated automatically
Proposed_Test: Inspect assumptions register status values

Requirement_Text: Output CSV shall include publication classification and synthetic label columns.
Assumptions: Public export metadata is required for every demo artifact
Proposed_Test: Inspect CSV headers for safety metadata columns

Requirement_Text: Thermal sensitivity sweep shall evaluate ambient temperature from -20 C to 85 C using synthetic cases.
Assumptions: Sweep range is synthetic and requires equation review
Proposed_Test: Run sensitivity sweep and inspect ambient-temperature plot
